title: The whole nutrition page, in the light-inside world
question: The tube you picked, made into a language for the entire screen: one soft white material, everything either raised out of it or pressed into it, and the only colour is the light inside the tubes. Three ways to arrange the page. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: Panels
options.thesis: Every group is its own raised panel: the tubes, the write-line, water, and one row per meal. The structure the app already has, rebuilt in the new material.
options.viewport: Tubes panel, write-line, water, three meal rows, tab bar.
options.risk: The most elements on screen of the three; the panels do a lot of quiet talking.

options.label: No panels at all
options.thesis: Nothing sits on a card. The tubes are pressed straight into the page and take the top half; the sections are separated only by space. The purest reading of your reference.
options.viewport: Tall tubes, write-line, water in one line, meals as bare rows.
options.risk: The meals are grey on grey - this is exactly the contrast failure the reference note warns about, and it would have to be fixed in the build.

options.label: Tubes, then tiles
options.thesis: The tubes card, then what is left as one large number, then the day as four soft tiles - the meals and the water side by side.
options.viewport: Tubes, 495 left, write-line, four tiles, tab bar.
options.risk: Four tiles fit four things; a day with six meals has to become a list again, so the screen changes shape as the day fills.
